entry.name: v8ui
entry.digest: Javascript user interfaces and graphics (Modern Engine)
entry.description: Provides an environment to make user interface elements using Javascript (ECMAScript 6+). This provides all of the programming tools available in the v8 object, but also exposes the mgraphics and sketch drawing routines for visual output.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.description: When a file is dragged from the File Browser to aobject, the file is loaded and executed.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Double-clicking on the object opens a text window where the Javascript source file can be edited. When the text window is saved, the text is compiled as the object's script.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Invokes the function with the message name, assigning the message arguments to the arguments to the function. For example, if the object has a function named xyz defined, the messagewould invoke the xyz function with arguments 1 2 and 3.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Invokes the function named bang if defined.

messages.name: compile
messages.description: Recompiles the current file. If followed by a symbol, will load, compile, and set the currently loaded Javascript file to be the file specified by the symbol argument.

messages.name: delprop
messages.description: The word, followed by a name, deletes the named property.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Invokes the function named msg_float if defined.

messages.name: getprop
messages.digest: Get the value of a named property
messages.description: The word, followed by a name, outputs the value of the property name stored in the object out the left outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Invokes the function named msg_int if defined.

messages.name: jsfile
messages.digest: Load and compile a Javascript file
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol , loads, compiles, and sets the currently loaded Javascript file to be the Javascript file specified by the symbol argument.

messages.name: loadbang
messages.digest: Invokes the function named loadbang if defined.

messages.name: open
messages.description: Opens the text window where the object's Javascript source file can be edited.

messages.name: setprop
messages.description: The word, followed by name and one or more names or numbers, sets the named property to what follows the name. For example, after sending setpropto the object, the xyz property would have a value of the list 1 2 3.

messages.name: size
messages.description: The word, followed by two int arguments, sets the width and height of theobject.

messages.name: wclose
messages.description: Closes the text window where the object's Javascript source file is edited.
